description.zh-CN: 存放 Open WebUI 会话审计导出的文件夹，留空使用平台根目录下的 audit-logs。导出内容含完整对话，请只授权可信账户访问。修改后需要重启入口服务和两个管理器。
description.en-US: The folder that holds the Open WebUI conversation audit exports; empty uses audit-logs under the platform root. Exports contain full conversations, so keep access to trusted accounts. A change needs the entry and both managers restarted.

description.zh-CN: 由入口服务按计划导出会话审计：定期增量，并在需要新基线时于固定时刻做完整导出。找不到 Open WebUI 容器时只记录跳过，不会启动任何容器。
description.en-US: Let the entry export the conversation audit on a schedule: periodic incrementals, and a full export at a fixed time when a new baseline is needed. If the Open WebUI container does not exist the run is only recorded as skipped, and no container is ever started.

description.zh-CN: 两次增量导出之间间隔的分钟数，范围 15 到 1440。
description.en-US: Minutes between incremental exports, from 15 to 1440.

description.zh-CN: 本机时间 HH:MM。完整基线超过保留天数后，会在此后的第一个该时刻重新做一次完整导出，使历史始终可恢复。
description.en-US: Local time as HH:MM. Once the full baseline is older than the baseline interval, a new full export runs at the first such time after that, so history stays recoverable.

description.zh-CN: 保留的审计导出数量软上限；最新的导出链不会被拆开，所以实际数量可能略多。
description.en-US: A soft cap on how many audit exports are kept. The newest chain is never split, so slightly more may stay.

description.zh-CN: 超过这个天数的较旧审计导出会被清理，最新的完整基线及其后的导出除外。
description.en-US: Older audit exports beyond this many days are pruned, except the newest full baseline and the exports after it.

description.zh-CN: 最新的完整导出超过这个天数后，需要重新做完整导出；0 表示不再自动重做基线。
description.en-US: Once the newest full export is older than this many days a new full export is needed; 0 turns automatic rebaselining off.

description.zh-CN: 一个完整导出加上其后的增量算一条导出链，只保留最新的这么多条；当前正在使用的链不会被删除。
description.en-US: One full export plus the incrementals after it make a chain, and only the newest chains are kept. The active chain is never removed.

description.zh-CN: 关闭时，审计访问记录里只保存搜索词的哈希和长度；开启后同时保存搜索原文，便于追溯，但记录本身会含有对话相关的词句。
description.en-US: When off, the audit access log keeps only the hash and length of a search term. When on it also keeps the text, which helps tracing but puts conversation words into the log.
